aiMetadata.description: Fetches the output artifacts (generated images/videos) of a specific Comfy.ICU workflow run, identified by workflow ID and run ID. Use after a run has completed to collect its produced files. Requires a valid run ID; read-only and safe to repeat.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Account Settings](https://comfy.icu/account).

aiMetadata.description: Returns the current execution status of a specific Comfy.ICU workflow run, identified by workflow ID and run ID. Use to poll or check whether a submitted run is still running, completed, or errored. Read-only and safe to repeat.
Lists all Comfy.ICU workflows available on the connected account. Use to discover workflow IDs before submitting a run or fetching run details. Takes no input; read-only and safe to repeat.

submit-workflow-run.description: Execute a workflow with specified prompt.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Account Settings](https://comfy.icu/account).

prompt.description: You can get workflow prompt by navigating to History->Select Run -> Copy API Workflow.

webhook.description: Webhook URL to recieve run status.

aiMetadata.description: Submits a new run of a Comfy.ICU workflow, queuing image/video generation with the given prompt graph (the API-format workflow JSON). Use to kick off generation; optionally supply a webhook URL to be notified of run status. Each call starts a new run, so it is not idempotent.

new-workflow-created.description: Triggers when a new workflow is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new workflow is created on the connected Comfy.ICU account, emitting that workflow. Polls the account workflow list and detects newly added workflows by creation time.
